description: Java interface for ExternalAssetOwnerTransfer repository, defining database access methods for ExternalAssetOwnerTransfer entities in the Fineract project.

classes.name: ExternalAssetOwnerTransferRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for ExternalAssetOwnerTransfer entities, providing methods for querying transfer data.

methods.name: findAllByLoanId
methods.description: Retrieves a page of ExternalAssetOwnerTransfer records by loan ID.

methods.name: findAllByExternalLoanId
methods.description: Retrieves a page of ExternalAssetOwnerTransfer records by external loan ID.

methods.name: findAllByExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves a page of ExternalAssetOwnerTransfer records by external ID.

methods.name: findLatestByLoanId
methods.description: Finds the most recent ExternalAssetOwnerTransfer for a given loan ID.

methods.name: findActiveByLoanId
methods.description: Finds the active ExternalAssetOwnerTransfer for a given loan ID.

methods.name: findActiveOwnerByLoanId
methods.description: Finds the active owner associated with a loan ID.

methods.name: findEffectiveTransfersOrderByIdDesc
methods.description: Finds effective transfers for a loan ID with an effective date after a specified date, ordered by ID descending.

methods.name: findFirstByExternalIdOrderByIdAsc
methods.description: Finds the first ExternalAssetOwnerTransfer by external ID, ordered by ID ascending.

methods.name: findLastByExternalIdOrderByIdDesc
methods.description: Finds the maximum ID for a given external transfer ID.

calls: select e from ExternalAssetOwnerTransfer e where e.loanId = :loanId and e.id = (select max(ex.id) from ExternalAssetOwnerTransfer ex where ex.loanId = :loanId)
select m.ownerTransfer from ExternalAssetOwnerTransferLoanMapping m inner join fetch m.ownerTransfer o where m.loanId = :loanId
select m.ownerTransfer.owner from ExternalAssetOwnerTransferLoanMapping m where m.loanId = :loanId
SELECT t FROM ExternalAssetOwnerTransfer t WHERE t.loanId = :loanId AND t.effectiveDateTo > :effectiveDate order by t.id desc
select max(e.id) from ExternalAssetOwnerTransfer e where e.externalId = :externalTransferId
